sections.heading: Introduction
sections.content:
Dear Dana Whitfield:

We represent Smith Logistics LLC in connection with Smith v. Acme Corp. We write in response to acme_demand_letter_scanned, dated [LETTER DATE] [1].

citations.quote: WHITFIELD & GRANT LLP 100 Market Street, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105 September 15, 2026 Smith Logistics LLC, 200 Harbor Way, Oakland, CA 94607 Re: Master Services Agreement dated March 1, 2025

sections.heading: Point 1: Payment of $48,500 in overdue invoices within fourteen…
sections.content:
Your letter states: “Payment of $48,500 in overdue invoices within fourteen (14) days of the date of this letter.” [2]

[PLACEHOLDER: our response to point 1]

sections.content:

sections.heading: Point 6: If Smith does not comply by September 29…
sections.content:

Please direct any further correspondence about this matter to the undersigned.

Sincerely,

Dev Lawyer
